items.prompt: The ___ between profit and cash has widened for three quarters.

This year, cash has not grown ___ profit.
If cash had not ___ behind profit, nobody would be asking questions today.
items.hintAfterError: Condicional misto: depois de 'had not' vem o particípio passado.

items.prompt: If the company had not ___ so many costs, profit would look smaller today.
The accounting is legal, but it is ___: very close to the limit.
The entries follow the letter of the rules, but not their ___.
If we had not ___ costs into the future, this year's profit would be lower.
If we ___ tracking the gap, the warning would have arrived later.
items.hintAfterError: Na oração com 'if' sobre o passado, use o past perfect (continuous).
